in_marathi.name: Sureshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fortune Bringer, Secure One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sureshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sureshkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words – ‘Suresh’ and ‘Kumar’. Suresh means ‘secure, fearless, and victorious’, while Kumar means ‘young boy, or prince’. Thus, Sureshkumar signifies someone who is a secure, fearless, and victorious young boy or prince.
